idea.text:
To judge a delegation,
ask who does which part.
idea.rep: find the contract, the checks and who checks

turn.cmd: Give me short delegation cases, one at a time. For each, I answer four questions. Is there a contract, and is it appropriate? Are the steps appropriate? Where are the checks, and who does them? Who evaluates, and is that appropriate? I must name the exact terms, handoff condition, testable, failure routing, delegation buckets, verification cost, unsupervised pipeline, sign-off authority and overtrust. Hold back your answer until I reply, then correct me in two sentences.
